abstract: A nationwide survey of hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) was started in Japan in 1991, and the analyzed survey data have been presented as the annual report of the Japan Society for Hematopoietic Cell Transplantation. The 10-year overall survival (OS) rates after HCT for each disease are as follows: acute myelogenous leukemia, 44.2%; acute lymphocytic leukemia, 33.7%; adult T-cell leukemia, 24.6%; chronic myelogenous leukemia, 53.3%; myelodysplastic syndrome, 37.3%; non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, 41.5%; Hodgkin's lymphoma, 50.8%; aplastic anemia, 72.5%; breast cancer, 37.1%; germ cell tumor, 52.6%; and ovarian cancer, 44.2%. The 5-year OS rates for multiple myeloma and lung cancer were 40.6% and 23.6%, respectively. Except in cord blood transplantation, engraftment was accomplished in more than 90% of patients. The respective frequencies of acute graft-versus-host disease (GVHD) and chronic GVHD were 41.1% and 34.9% for related bone marrow transplantation (BMT), 66.8% and 34.5% for unrelated BMT, 52.9% and 36.0% for allogeneic peripheral blood stem cell transplantation, and 53.3% and 32.1% for allogeneic cord blood transplantation. OS for each disease was analyzed by patient age, stem cell source, donor type, disease status, and disease type. These data provide objective and valuable information for hematologists as well as for patients who need HCT.
abstract_ja: 日本における造血細胞移植（HCT）の全国調査は1991年に開始され、解析された調査データは日本造血細胞移植学会の年次報告として発表されている。各疾患の移植後10年全生存期間(全生存率、OS)は以下のとおりである：急性骨髄性白血病44.2%、急性リンパ性白血病33.7%、成人T細胞白血病24.6%、慢性骨髄性白血病53.3%、骨髄異形成症候群37.3%、非ホジキンリンパ腫41.5%、ホジキンリンパ腫50.8%、再生不良性貧血72.5%、乳癌37.1%、胚細胞腫瘍52.6%、卵巣癌44.2%。多発性骨髄腫および肺癌の5年OSはそれぞれ40.6%および23.6%であった。臍帯血移植を除き、90%を超える患者で生着が達成された。急性移植片対宿主病（GVHD）および慢性GVHDの頻度は、血縁骨髄移植で41.1%および34.9%、非血縁骨髄移植で66.8%および34.5%、同種末梢血幹細胞移植で52.9%および36.0%、同種臍帯血移植で53.3%および32.1%であった。各疾患のOSは、患者年齢、幹細胞源、ドナー種別、疾患の状態、疾患の種類別に解析された。これらのデータは、HCTを必要とする患者および血液専門医にとって客観的で有益な情報を提供する。
